simulator.code_chivalric.rule_name: Code Chivalric (Oath of Honour — martial-valour Quality)
simulator.code_chivalric.quoted_text: If your Army Faction is IMPERIAL KNIGHTS, at the end of the Read Mission Objectives step, you must determine your army's Oath for the coming battle. An Oath consists of two parts - one Deed and one Quality. [Quality: ...with our martial valour risen over all.] Each time this model is selected to shoot or fight, you can re-roll one Hit roll and you can re-roll one Wound roll.
simulator.code_chivalric.trigger: Attacker's army faction is Imperial Knights and the army has taken the 'martial valour' Quality at battle start (SwegHammer always picks this Quality — the other two Qualities are a Move/Advance/Charge bump and an OC/Leadership bump that the simulator cannot express).
simulator.code_chivalric.effect: (APPROXIMATION) Re-roll natural 1s on the Hit roll and on the Wound roll for every attack the unit makes. The codex grants 're-roll one die of choice' per attack sequence; SwegHammer maps that to 're-roll natural 1s', which is strictly weaker (~+0.17 expected vs +0.5 expected on a 3+/4+ swing) and so under-buffs rather than over-buffs Imperial Knights. The implementation lives in code/units.py:Unit.attack, faction-gated to 'Imperial Knights' so the Chaos Knights army rule (Harbingers of Dread, a battle-shock aura that requires per-unit battleshock state the sim does not yet track) is untouched.
